name: Cloud image referencing build artifact must match by hash
description: A service running in your cloud was not matched to an artifact from your build system.
detailedDescription: An image hash not matched to a build artifact may indicate a compromise of the cloud account. An unauthorized application may be running in your organization's cloud. A crypto miner is an example of this.
